<!-- plain-summary -->
This step produces a published report showing the external checker ran a genuine, non-trivial test under failure and returned a verdict, including what was exercised, which faults were injected, how much history was examined, and which correctness model was used. It turns "trust us, we don't lose data" into a public, externally-recognizable artifact that outsiders can inspect for themselves.

**Slice 5 of #329.** Produce the externally-recognizable artifact — DoD item 2.

**Done when:**
- The harness asserts the ADR-0015 contract over the commit + repair path under partitions/crashes and the checker returns a **non-vacuous** verdict (Elle validates a real register/list-append model, not client bookkeeping).
- A published report (recognizable like the conformance vectors) records the run: workload, nemesis, history size, model, verdict.

**Depends on:** #329.3, #329.4. **Refs:** #329, ADR-0041, `architecture/10-quality-risks-glossary.md` (credibility-artifact framing).

comments.body: Re-milestoned to **Metadata Store FoundationDB** (M14). Per ADR-0042 the production distributed backend is FoundationDB, so the checked consistency run / public credibility artifact (this issue) and the privileged CI + bug→DST loop (#409) must target the **FDB** cluster, not the soon-to-be-fallback TiKV stack. The backend-agnostic harness pieces — the Elle register/list-append models (#406) and the partition nemesis (#407) — stay in M4 and are reused here. Parent tracker #329.

milestone.title: M4 — Production metadata backend
milestone.description: Step 2. Swap embedded redb for distributed TiKV behind the unchanged MetadataStore trait; multi-key atomic directory ops hold under the distributed store. Completes the single-zone data plane — a soft stopping point, not the release: the ★ Step-2 release point is M8 (proposal 0013 implementation arc, supersedes 0002). Plan: proposal 0015 (supersedes 0007; acceptance PR #417); tracker #201; first-deployment gate #367.
